summary: Verified both bug fixes in Presento backend. 25/25 pytest tests passed including 4 new tests specifically targeting the reported bugs: (1) null-title slide ValidationError fix, (2) loremflickr replacement for deprecated source.unsplash.com. All 21 prior tests still pass (1 old assertion updated to match new URL host).

minor.issue: loremflickr.com returns tagged Flickr photos but the image content may still vary in quality/relevance vs real Unsplash. Works reliably for now (returns real JPEG, 200 OK, ~30-100KB per image verified).
Still inserts a new user_sessions doc each call without upsert/cleanup -> unbounded growth. Carryover from iteration_1.
Accepts arbitrary dict body without Pydantic validation. Carryover from iteration_1.
Does not restrict schemes or block private IPs -> SSRF risk. Carryover from iteration_1.

critical_code_review_comments: Bug #1 fix verified: Slide.title is now Optional[str]='' and presentations_generate normalizes None->'' via (s.get('title') or '') — test_generate_handles_null_slide_fields_via_monkeypatch confirms end-to-end with monkeypatched LLM returning null fields.

Bug #2 fix verified: fetch_unsplash now returns https://loremflickr.com/1200/675/{tags}/all?lock={hash}. The URL resolves with HTTP 200 and image/* content-type (verified by fetching returned URL in test_unsplash_returns_valid_image).
server.py still ~810 lines — consider splitting into routers (carryover).
Synchronous httpx.get() inside build_pptx blocks event loop (carryover from iteration_1).
CORS allow_origins='*' with allow_credentials=True is rejected by browsers (carryover).
test_credentials: No real credentials needed. Test user+session seeded directly in MongoDB (user_TEST_* / TEST_token_*) via session-scoped fixture.
seed_data_creation: Session-scoped fixture creates one TEST_ user + session in MongoDB; cleanup on teardown removes user, session and all TEST presentations.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Suite has 25 tests. New tests of note: test_slide_builds_with_null_fields (direct Slide model unit test), test_unsplash_returns_valid_image (fetches loremflickr URL to confirm real image), test_generate_endpoint_does_not_500_on_llm_failure (confirms no 500 path), test_generate_handles_null_slide_fields_via_monkeypatch (monkeypatches run_llm with fastapi TestClient to exercise full endpoint with null section-slide fields — returns 200, slides normalized). No real LLM key required for any test.
rca of the issue: Bug #1 RCA: section slides from LLM have title:null; Slide.title was required str -> pydantic 500. Fix: Slide.title made Optional[str]='' AND endpoint normalizes None to '' during Slide(...) construction. Verified via monkeypatched run_llm returning JSON with null title/body/bullets — returns 200 with empty strings. Bug #2 RCA: source.unsplash.com deprecated in 2023 -> images never loaded. Fix: switched to loremflickr.com/1200/675/{tags}/all?lock={hash} (no key required, deterministic per prompt). Verified returns real image (200, image/jpeg, >1KB).
